unit: Each project has one primary result category: affirmative, counterexample, partial answer, or construction/classification. Parallel treatment is an overlapping provenance tag.
family_grouping: One core-question group per listed project; principal result, supporting arguments and extensions remain in that group.
partial_results_meaning: Particular cases or partial conclusions for broader original questions; does not mean only post-solution extensions.
extension_count_meaning: Families with subsequent generalizations or constructions; overlaps partial results and does not imply the full original question was settled.
